name: ui-test
description: Agent-driven UI testing for FileMaker Pro builds: Claude writes a typed test instruction, a Codex computer-use worker runs it under Ringer and returns an evidence receipt (screenshots + values read off the screen), executed checks validate the receipt, and a separate verifier issues the verdict. Outcomes are PASS-OBSERVED / FAIL / BLOCKED. Requires Ringer and a one-time Codex computer-use approval for FileMaker Pro.
